parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: This is the lens of the camera, made primarily of optical glass. It is cylindrical and located at the front of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: The lens focuses light onto the camera sensor to capture images with clarity and precision.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly for zooming or focusing, either manually or automatically.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is a control button on the top of the camera, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to trigger the shutter or control camera functions such as power or mode selection.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another button on the camera, also made of plastic, likely used for secondary functions such as zoom or menu navigation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides user input for camera settings or operational control.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its resting position.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the camera, made of aluminum alloy for strength and lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses all internal components, provides structural integrity, and supports external parts like the lens and buttons.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the structural frame of the camera.
